description: This file provides compatibility API endpoints for various job-related operations, forwarding calls to version 1 implementations. It exposes routes for creating, deleting, uploading assets, analyzing, retrieving status/results, asset previews, fixing assets, and downloading reports, all mapped to v1 functions for backward compatibility.

methods.name: _error_payload(status_code: int, message: str)
methods.description: Generates a standardized error payload for HTTP responses.

methods.description: Endpoint to create a job, forwarding request to v1 handler.

methods.description: Endpoint to delete a job, forwarding request to v1 handler.
